scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:shell" "npm run dev:student" "npm run dev:teacher" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:modules && npm run build:shell
scripts.build:modules: concurrently "npm run build:student" "npm run build:teacher" "npm run build:admin" "npm run build:courses"
scripts.install:apps: concurrently "cd apps/shell && npm install" "cd apps/student-dashboard && npm install" "cd apps/teacher-dashboard && npm install" "cd apps/admin-dashboard && npm install" "cd apps/course-modules && npm install" "cd apps/shared-components && npm install"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: concurrently "npm run test:shell" "npm run test:student" "npm run test:teacher"
scripts.lint:all: concurrently "npm run lint:shell" "npm run lint:student" "npm run lint:teacher"
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && npm run deploy:modules:staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && npm run deploy:modules:production
scripts.deploy:modules:staging: concurrently "npm run deploy:shell:staging" "npm run deploy:student:staging" "npm run deploy:teacher:staging"
scripts.deploy:modules:production: concurrently "npm run deploy:shell:production" "npm run deploy:student:production" "npm run deploy:teacher:production"
